verdict.rationale: Autonomous background automations are a fair question for a payroll and finance SaaS like Gusto, so the axis applies. However, the evidence covers only business formation, banking, and a cash-flow Money Dashboard, with nothing about user-configurable automations or agents that run on their own. The evidence comes mainly from press releases because gusto.com blocked crawling, so first-party docs on automation may simply be uncaptured, which keeps confidence at medium.
